Emma (CEO): Morning team — short executive update for the week. Quick highlights: Hosted API revenue +18% WoW, Dedicated reserved capacity +2 nodes, and our first Private pilot with Acme is approved to start next month. P99 latency improved ~12ms after the runtime kernel patch. Priorities for the week: 1) finish fallback routing and canary policy for model rollouts, 2) tune Dedicated autoscaler, 3) ship Redwood Optimize v1 suggestions, 4) finalize EU data residency checklist for Private.
Mike (VP Eng): Solid. For fallback routing I'll roll the canary with `--routing=smart-failover` by EOD. Need infra signoff and a short runbook for on-call.
Tara (VP Product): Please add a visibility panel in Console for rollout health — per-route status and last-fallback reason. I'll own the UX copy and product tests.
Sam (Head of Ops): Incident recap: last night we had a 9m degradation on DAL cluster-3 caused by a kernel mismatch in the new runtime build; rollback restored normal service. I'm scheduling a postmortem Thurs 10:00 PT. No customer-facing impact recorded.
Jen (CFO): Heads-up for Friday's finance sync: we beat hosted revenue but margins are sensitive to Dedicated SSD spend. I'll share a revised forecast by Thursday EOD.
deploy-bot: deploy completed on cluster-dal-3 commit abc123 (1765003000) :white_check_mark:
Sarah (Reliability): Request: freeze model architecture upgrades on Hosted during the Thursday maintenance window to avoid KV cache invalidation. Also proposing a small test harness to simulate prefix caching failover.
Oliver (Sales): FYI closed MNO Corp for Dedicated — contract signed, onboarding to start Jan 5. Nice cross-team work from solutions.
Emma (CEO): Thanks everyone. Two asks: a) each lead add one-line blockers + where you need help to the weekly doc by tomorrow, b) join a brief town hall Friday 11:00 PT — I'll share the roadmap and Q4 targets. :calendar:
Mike (VP Eng): ACK. I'll post autoscaler metrics and a short playbook here once infra signs off.
Tara (VP Product): Adding experiment: surface per-route cost in Console (prototype next week) — will coordinate with DevEx.
Sam (Head of Ops): Postmortem Thurs 10am; autoscaler load test Thurs 15:00; will post commands and logs here.
Jen (CFO): Sharing revised projections Thu EOD. Quick note: please route any Dedicated procurement asks through finance before signing.
Emma (CEO): One more — shoutout to eng-runtime for the latency wins. Keep focus on reliability and predictable economics. :clap:
